bundle_summary: Advance generic, non-IP aesthetic niches (Y2K, 90s nostalgia, anime-style posters, horror aesthetic merch, office desk decor). Quarantine all Iron Lung/game/movie and named-person/book IP. Product-generic terms serve as ingredients only, not standalone niches.
bundle_warnings: Multiple candidates reference named IP or individuals and are quarantined (Project Hail Mary, Iron Lung game/movie/popcorn items, Markiplier).
Ambiguous 'iron lung' terms likely tied to IP; not advanced without independent generic support.
Generic product terms are treated as ingredients, not standalone niches.

hypotheses.audience_or_buyer: Gen Z and Millennials seeking late-1990s/early-2000s aesthetic
hypotheses.concise_evidence: Strong demand leader for 'y2k' with high clicks; complementary product surfaces via stickers and apparel terms.
hypotheses.label: Y2K aesthetic across stickers and apparel
likely_validation_surfaces: Etsy search term performance for y2k stickers/shirts
Category-level bestseller density in Y2K aesthetic
Cross-surface presence in apparel and sticker subcategories
hypotheses.uncertainty: High competition; broad aesthetic may be saturated.

hypotheses.concise_evidence: '90s' shows notable clicks despite very high competition; aligns with broad nostalgia demand.
hypotheses.label: 90s nostalgia aesthetic designs
hypotheses.uncertainty: Extremely broad term; needs narrowing without drifting into named IP.

hypotheses.audience_or_buyer: Anime fans seeking style-based wall art without specific titles
hypotheses.concise_evidence: 'anime poster' has strong clicks; viable as style-only if kept non-branded.
hypotheses.label: Anime-style posters (original, non-branded)
likely_validation_surfaces: Etsy search for anime style poster/original art
Poster category bestseller patterns for anime-style terms
hypotheses.theme_identity_or_occasion: Anime-inspired illustration style for home decor
hypotheses.uncertainty: Risk of drift into specific titles/characters; must stay generic.

hypotheses.audience_or_buyer: Horror fans who want genre-themed designs without named movies
hypotheses.concise_evidence: 'horror movie merch' shows demand; reframed to genre aesthetic to avoid IP.
hypotheses.label: Horror aesthetic merch (non-franchise)
likely_validation_surfaces: Etsy search for horror aesthetic merch/apparel
hypotheses.theme_identity_or_occasion: General horror motifs (e.g., spooky, gothic) without IP
hypotheses.uncertainty: Buyers may expect franchises; need to ensure style-first queries exist.

hypotheses.concise_evidence: 'office desk decor' has measurable clicks; aligns with common POD surfaces (prints).
hypotheses.label: Office desk decor prints and accessories (generic)
likely_validation_surfaces: Etsy search for office desk decor prints
hypotheses.uncertainty: High KD and broad intent; ensure POD-led listings are visible.
